ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell script and alike. Mimikatz is a credential dumper capable of obtaining plaintext Windows account logins and passwords. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*DumpCreds.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*DumpCerts.*")) OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*sekurlsa\\:\\:logonpasswords.*") OR (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*crypto\\:\\:certificates.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*CERT\\_SYSTEM\\_STORE\\_LOCAL\\_MACHINE.*")))
